_note: Artist tags the generator must never draw, and never accept as a typed artist. Consulted by enhancer._artist_pool() and by the VL job. Names are danbooru artist tags, lowercase.
_method: Added on EVIDENCE, not on the name. A keyword sweep over the 48,167 drawable artists flagged 12 names containing loli/shota/child/gore etc; sampling 40 posts each showed most are ordinary handles where the word is incidental ('child (isoliya)' 0%, 'gore (white gore)' 0%). Blanket keyword banning would have removed legitimate artists, and 'lolita' also names a real fashion style.
